articles.title: Islam: Muslimischer Fastenmonat Ramadan beginnt
articles.teaser: In mehreren Ländern hat der islamische Fastenmonat begonnen, darunter Saudi-Arabien und der Libanon. In Deutschland startet der Ramadan am Donnerstag.
articles.image_title: Islam: People watch as a man uses a telescope while searching for the crescent moon to mark the start of the Muslim holy fasting month of Ramadan, near the Dome of the Rock Shrine at the Al-Aqsa mosque compound, in the Old City of Jerusalem on February 17, 2026. For Muslims across the world, the beginning of the ninth month in the Muslim lunar calendar which marks the start of Ramadan, is a time for spiritual reflection, prayers, fasting and family reunions around the table after breaking the fast. (Photo by AHMAD GHARABLI / AFP via Getty Images)
